basics.name: Teemu Aaltola
basics.label: Senior Software and Cloud Security Engineer
basics.summary:
Teemu Aaltola is a senior software and cloud security engineer with a strong background in designing, securing, and maintaining cloud infrastructure and software solutions, particularly in AWS and other cloud environments.

Teemu’s core strengths are cloud security, cybersecurity, cloud architecture, infrastructure, backend development, and DevSecOps. His software engineering background gives him a practical understanding of how applications and cloud platforms are built, enabling him to identify security risks across application, infrastructure, and deployment layers. He is also comfortable working with modern frontend technologies when required.

Teemu has a strong interest in application security, cloud security, secure architecture, vulnerability assessment, and identifying potential attack paths within modern cloud-native systems. He approaches security from an engineering perspective, focusing not only on identifying vulnerabilities but also on understanding their real-world impact and how they can be effectively mitigated.

Teemu is passionate about continuously developing his cybersecurity and engineering expertise. He actively invests time in hands-on security research, security testing, cloud technologies, and modern cybersecurity practices, while continuously expanding his technical knowledge.
basics.x-tagline: Tracking down security weaknesses and getting them fixed is what a security engineer is here for.

x-strengths.title: Where security, code, and infrastructure meet
x-strengths.description:
Teemu thrives at the intersection of cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, and software engineering. He enjoys solving complex technical and security challenges, particularly where understanding the complete system—from application code and APIs to cloud infrastructure, networking, and deployment—is essential.

Teemu has worked across a wide range of business domains, including gaming, telecom, and industrial environments. His broad engineering background allows him to approach security challenges with an understanding of how modern systems are actually designed, built, deployed, and operated.

Teemu is a collaborative team player who approaches security with both technical and business needs in mind. He works effectively with developers, architects, infrastructure teams, and stakeholders to identify risks and find practical solutions.

Rather than treating security as a separate layer or blocker, Teemu aims to integrate it into architecture, development, and operations. He is comfortable challenging existing approaches when necessary while focusing on solutions that are secure, maintainable, and realistic for the teams responsible for them.
